from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,math,ast
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.font_manager import FontProperties
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_monthly_account_target_gap_diagnostic_v1"
REL=OUT.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
BASE=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_multidim_money_surprise_score_v1"
assert not (OUT/"result.json").exists(),"诊断已完成，停止重复执行。"
proto=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
sources=json.loads((OUT/"source_parent_hashes.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def digest(name): return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for source in sources: assert digest(source["path"])==source["sha256"],"来源身份变化："+source["path"]
def clean(value):
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:clean(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,(list,tuple)):return [clean(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value,(np.bool_,)):return bool(value)
    if isinstance(value,(np.integer,)):return int(value)
    if isinstance(value,(float,np.floating)):return float(value) if math.isfinite(float(value)) else None
    if isinstance(value,pd.Timestamp):return value.isoformat()
    return value
def save(name,value):
    path=OUT/name
    assert not path.exists(),"不覆盖诊断文件："+name
    path.write_text(json.dumps(clean(value),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
saved=pd.read_csv(BASE/"完整账户指标.csv")
cycles=pd.read_csv(BASE/"全部账户自然交易周期.csv")
cycles["entry"]=pd.to_datetime(cycles["entry"])
cycles["exit"]=pd.to_datetime(cycles["exit"])
metrics_rows=[];cycle_rows=[];annual_rows=[];path_rows=[];checks=[]
ledgers={}
for ident in proto["cases"]:
    ledger=pd.read_parquet(BASE/"accounts"/(ident+".parquet")).reset_index(drop=True)
    ledger["date"]=pd.to_datetime(ledger["date"])
    assert ledger["date"].is_monotonic_increasing and ledger["date"].is_unique
    capital=200000.0 if ident.endswith("_200000") else 20000.0
    assert np.all(ledger["terminal_exit_reserve"].to_numpy(float)==0),"退出准备非0，原简化解释路径不能运行。"
    eq=ledger["equity"].to_numpy(float)
    fees=(ledger["commission"]+ledger["slippage_cost"]).to_numpy(float)
    refunded=eq+np.cumsum(fees)
    for i,row in enumerate(ledger.itertuples()):
        path_rows.append({"case_id":ident,"date":row.date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),"original_equity":eq[i],
                          "same_holdings_refund_equity":refunded[i],"fees_refunded_to_date":float(fees[:i+1].sum()),
                          "original_shares":int(row.shares),"not_new_order_or_engine_account":True})
    source_cycles=cycles[cycles["case_id"].eq(ident)].copy().sort_values("entry")
    assert source_cycles["closed"].all()
    assert abs(source_cycles["profit"].sum()-(eq[-1]-capital))<1e-6
    for cr in source_cycles.to_dict("records"):
        position=int(cr["entry_row"]);buy=ledger.iloc[position]
        assert buy["date"]==cr["entry"] and buy["filled_quantity"]>0 and buy["shares_before"]==0
        block=ledger[ledger["date"].between(cr["entry"],cr["exit"])]
        friction=float((block["commission"]+block["slippage_cost"]).sum())
        assert abs(friction-float(cr["paid_friction"]))<1e-7
        assert abs(cr["gross_same_holdings_profit"]-(cr["profit"]+friction))<1e-7
        initial_notional=float(cr["initial_quantity"])*float(buy["open_price"])
        assert initial_notional>0 and cr["start_equity"]>0
        cr.update(entry=cr["entry"].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),exit=cr["exit"].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                  initial_market_notional=initial_notional,
                  entry_initial_notional_fraction=initial_notional/cr["start_equity"],
                  actual_cycle_nav_return=cr["profit"]/cr["start_equity"],
                  same_exit_path_net_per_initial_notional=cr["profit"]/initial_notional,
                  same_exit_path_gross_per_initial_notional=cr["gross_same_holdings_profit"]/initial_notional,
                  friction_nav_return=friction/cr["start_equity"],
                  fixed_trade_path_projection_not_executable=True)
        assert abs(cr["actual_cycle_nav_return"]-
                   (cr["entry_initial_notional_fraction"]*cr["same_exit_path_gross_per_initial_notional"]-cr["friction_nav_return"]))<1e-12
        cycle_rows.append(cr)
    case_cycle=pd.DataFrame([x for x in cycle_rows if x["case_id"]==ident])
    for year in range(2021,2026):
        yr=case_cycle[pd.to_datetime(case_cycle["entry"]).dt.year.eq(year)]
        annual_rows.append({"case_id":ident,"year":year,"cycles":len(yr),
                            "net_cycle_profit":float(yr["profit"].sum()),"paid_friction":float(yr["paid_friction"].sum()),
                            "meets_five":len(yr)>=5})
    for period in proto["periods"]:
        indexes=np.flatnonzero(ledger["date"].between(period["start"],period["end"]))
        assert len(indexes)>1 and np.all(np.diff(indexes)==1)
        first,last=int(indexes[0]),int(indexes[-1])
        initial=capital if first==0 else float(eq[first-1])
        prior_shares=0 if first==0 else int(ledger["shares"].iloc[first-1])
        assert prior_shares==0 and int(ledger["shares"].iloc[last])==0,"跨段持仓不能改成闭合周期。"
        part=ledger.iloc[indexes]
        nav=np.r_[initial,eq[indexes]]
        returns=part["net_return"].to_numpy(float)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(returns,nav[1:]/nav[:-1]-1,rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
        n=len(indexes);sd=float(returns.std(ddof=1))
        recomputed={"days":n,"start_equity":initial,"end_equity":float(nav[-1]),"net_profit":float(nav[-1]-initial),
                    "net_sharpe":float(np.sqrt(242)*returns.mean()/sd) if sd>1e-15 else None,
                    "cagr":float((nav[-1]/initial)**(242/n)-1),
                    "max_drawdown":float(1-np.min(nav/np.maximum.accumulate(nav))),
                    "mean_exposure":float(part["exposure"].mean()),
                    "commission":float(part["commission"].sum()),"slippage":float(part["slippage_cost"].sum())}
        old=saved[saved["case_id"].eq(ident)&saved["period"].eq(period["name"])]
        assert len(old)==1
        old=old.iloc[0]
        for key,value in recomputed.items():
            tolerance=1e-6 if key in ["start_equity","end_equity","net_profit","commission","slippage"] else 1e-10
            assert abs(float(value)-float(old[key]))<tolerance,(ident,period["name"],key,value,old[key])
        period_cycle=case_cycle[pd.to_datetime(case_cycle["entry"]).between(period["start"],period["end"])].copy()
        assert pd.to_datetime(period_cycle["exit"]).le(period["end"]).all()
        counts={str(y):int(pd.to_datetime(period_cycle["entry"]).dt.year.eq(y).sum())
                for y in range(int(period["start"][:4]),int(period["end"][:4])+1)}
        assert ast.literal_eval(old["annual_complete_cycles"])==counts
        cycle_product=float(np.prod(1+period_cycle["actual_cycle_nav_return"].to_numpy(float)))
        assert abs(cycle_product-nav[-1]/initial)<1e-10
        assert abs(float(period_cycle["profit"].sum())-recomputed["net_profit"])<1e-6
        period_friction=float(fees[indexes].sum())
        assert abs(float(period_cycle["paid_friction"].sum())-period_friction)<1e-6
        c0=capital if first==0 else float(refunded[first-1])
        cf_nav=np.r_[c0,refunded[indexes]]
        cf_returns=cf_nav[1:]/cf_nav[:-1]-1
        cf_sd=float(cf_returns.std(ddof=1))
        cf_cagr=float((cf_nav[-1]/c0)**(242/n)-1)
        # 两条比例路径只作解释；不调用账户引擎，不应用新风险或产生新交易。
        effective=period_cycle["same_exit_path_gross_per_initial_notional"].to_numpy(float)
        uniform=float(np.prod(1+.5*effective))
        clairvoyant=float(np.prod(1+.5*np.maximum(effective,0)))
        assert clairvoyant>=uniform-1e-12
        count=len(period_cycle)
        target_multiplier=1.1**(n/242)
        cycle_needed=target_multiplier**(1/count)-1 if count else None
        row={**recomputed,"case_id":ident,"period":period["name"],
             "cycles":count,"annual_cycles":json.dumps(counts,ensure_ascii=False),"all_years_five":all(v>=5 for v in counts.values()),
             "days_with_stock_at_close":int(part["shares"].gt(0).sum()),
             "fraction_days_without_stock_at_close":float(part["shares"].eq(0).mean()),
             "mean_exposure_on_holding_closes":float(part.loc[part["shares"].gt(0),"exposure"].mean()),
             "mean_entry_initial_notional_fraction":float(period_cycle["entry_initial_notional_fraction"].mean()),
             "cycle_nav_geometric_mean":float(cycle_product**(1/count)-1) if count else None,
             "mean_gross_effective_return_per_initial_notional":float(effective.mean()) if count else None,
             "paid_friction":period_friction,"net_growth_multiplier":float(nav[-1]/initial),
             "ten_percent_target_growth_multiplier":target_multiplier,
             "ten_percent_target_end_nav":float(initial*target_multiplier),
             "target_profit_gap_cny":float(initial*target_multiplier-nav[-1]),
             "equal_nav_return_each_observed_cycle_needed":cycle_needed,
             "same_holdings_refund_cagr":cf_cagr,
             "same_holdings_refund_sharpe":float(np.sqrt(242)*cf_returns.mean()/cf_sd) if cf_sd>1e-15 else None,
             "same_holdings_refund_profit_for_period":float(cf_nav[-1]-c0),
             "uniform_50_no_fee_same_exit_path_cagr":float(uniform**(242/n)-1),
             "perfect_hindsight_50_no_fee_same_exit_path_cagr_ceiling":float(clairvoyant**(242/n)-1),
             "projection_ceiling_scope":"原有限周期/原退出份额比例/无费用/首仓<=50%；事后跳过所有非正毛周期。不是其他退出、其他窗口或新策略的上界。",
             "largest_cycle_share_of_net_profit":float(period_cycle["profit"].max()/recomputed["net_profit"]) if recomputed["net_profit"]>0 else None,
             "new_engine_account":False}
        metrics_rows.append(row)
        checks.append({"case_id":ident,"period":period["name"],"original_metrics_recomputed":True,
                       "original_cycles_and_fees_reconciled":True,"cycle_product_equals_original_nav":True,
                       "original_rows":n,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0})
        print(ident,period["name"],"原年化",round(row["cagr"]*100,6),"返费年化",round(cf_cagr*100,6),
              "事后完美半仓原路径上限",round(row["perfect_hindsight_50_no_fee_same_exit_path_cagr_ceiling"]*100,6),
              "周期",count)
metrics=pd.DataFrame(metrics_rows)
cycle_frame=pd.DataFrame(cycle_rows)

assert primary["same_holdings_refund_cagr"]<.1
